meta.title: Security | Studioz
meta.description: How Studioz protects payments and customer data with tokenization and PCI-compliant processors.

hero.subtitle: Studioz minimizes PCI scope with a hosted, tokenized payment flow. Card data is handled by a PCI DSS Level 1–compliant processor — not our servers.

payment.title: Payment Infrastructure
payment.subtitle: Payment processing is handled by a PCI DSS Level 1–certified provider. We do not store, process, or transmit cardholder data on our servers.

tokenization.title: Client-Side Tokenization
tokenization.description: Sensitive financial data never touches our servers. Modern web security protocols keep card data with the payment gateway.

points.directToGateway: Card data is sent directly to our payment gateway's secure API
points.singleUseToken: Our servers only receive a single-use token
points.zeroExposure: Zero exposure of raw card numbers or CVV codes during transit

storage.title: Secure Data Storage
storage.description: We follow a need-to-know policy. If we don't need it to operate the service, we don't store it.

points.licensedProcessors: Full card data is stored exclusively by licensed processors
points.referenceIds: We only retain reference IDs for recurring billing
points.lastFourOnly: Only the last 4 digits are stored for identification
points.securityAudits: Regular reviews of our data retention policies

dataMatrix.title: Data Transparency
dataMatrix.subtitle: A clear view of what we do and don't store on our systems.

invoicing.title: Automated Invoicing
invoicing.subtitle: Financial documents are handled through secure API integrations with accounting platforms.

tokenAuth.title: Token-Authenticated Access
tokenAuth.description: Our systems authenticate with invoicing partners using time-limited, encrypted access tokens.

webhooks.title: Webhook Integrity
webhooks.description: Payment status updates are verified via authenticated webhooks for transaction accuracy.

auditTrail.title: Comprehensive Audit Trail
auditTrail.description: Document records are logged for record-keeping and tax compliance.

cta.title: Have security questions?
cta.subtitle: Our team can provide additional detail on compliance and data handling.
